name: Barbell Spoto Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with feet grounded, set your shoulder blades, and unrack the barbell over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly toward your lower chest under strict control with your forearms vertical.
Pause with the bar just clear of your chest, keeping it motionless.
Press the bar firmly back up over your shoulders until your arms reach full extension.
tips: Hold the hover under full muscular control without dipping the bar lower before pressing.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.
